rule: Two drawings share one line colour: a template with coloured enclosed pockets, and an empty outline of the same design with different proportions. Output the outline's bounding box, keeping only its own line cells. Flood each enclosed outline pocket with the majority colour of the template pocket whose normalised centroid is nearest. Template pockets that are background stay background.
scope: Transfer pocket colours from a template to an empty outline of the same banded topology with different proportions; crop the outline. Two to four bands of one to three pockets, random pocket-size upper bound configurable through 6 (default 4), optional symmetric sampling. Exact grid dimensions, palette, latent band geometry and placements are supported, subject to margin and centroid-identifiability constraints.

authored_scope: Random scenes are banded designs. Each has 2-4 bands of 1-3 rectangular pockets, with band heights and pocket widths of 1-3 each. Bands are centred to give stepped silhouettes. Mirror symmetry is optional, and some template pockets may stay background. Template and outline share topology but have independently sampled proportions. They are placed side by side or stacked with a gap. Grid size, background colour, line colour and palette are all randomised. The original free-form fixtures are replayed from explicit sprites and positions. Not supported: free-form or non-rectangular pockets in random scenes, distractor objects, more than two drawings, and overlapping bounding boxes.
authored_constraints: Background, line and pocket colours are pairwise distinct; at least two template pockets are coloured.
Outline proportions differ from the template's. Each outline pocket's nearest template centroid is its own counterpart, with a squared-distance margin of 2x over the next nearest.
Template and outline bounding boxes are disjoint, with at least one empty row or column between them, so they never touch even diagonally.
Background cells form a strict majority of the grid, so the background is the unambiguous most common colour. This fixes the earlier failures, where the line colour outnumbered the background.
Every pocket is fully enclosed by line walls, and exterior background regions touch the crop edge.
The template has at least two colours and the outline exactly one, so their roles cannot be confused.
